altinity-clickhouse-operator.description: Values of Altinity's clickhouse-operator chart, which installs the operator that reconciles the ClickHouseInstallation. Only settings that differ from that chart's defaults are set here. Its keys: https://github.com/Altinity/clickhouse-operator/tree/release-0.27.4/deploy/helm @ignored

clickhouse.description: The ClickHouse this chart installs, a ClickHouseInstallation that the operator from `altinity-clickhouse-operator` reconciles.

allowedNetworkIps.description: Networks `clickhouse.user` may connect from, as addresses or CIDR ranges. The defaults are the private ranges. Add any other range a client connects from.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ClickHouseInstallation.

cluster.description: Name of the ClickHouse cluster, which the migrator creates SigNoz's tables on and SigNoz queries.

coldStorage.description: S3 or GCS disk added as the `s3` volume of a `tiered` storage policy, where SigNoz's retention settings move older data.

accessKey.description: Access key ID for S3 or GCS. ClickHouse uses it for `gcs`, and for `s3` when `role.enabled` is false.

defaultKeepFreeSpaceBytes.description: Free space to keep on the default disk, in bytes.

enabled.description: Enable cold storage on S3 or Google Cloud Storage (GCS).

endpoint.description: Bucket URL including the path ClickHouse writes under. @raw An S3 bucket:  ```yaml endpoint: https://my-bucket.s3-us-east-1.amazonaws.com/data/ ```  or a GCS bucket:  ```yaml endpoint: https://storage.googleapis.com/my-bucket/data/ ```

role.description: AWS IAM role that gives ClickHouse access to the `s3` bucket in place of `accessKey` and `secretAccess`.

annotations.description: ServiceAccount annotations that bind the role, added when `coldStorage.enabled` and `role.enabled` are both true.

enabled.description: Use the role for `s3`: ClickHouse takes credentials from its environment instead of `accessKey` and `secretAccess`.

secretAccess.description: Secret access key for S3 or GCS. ClickHouse uses it for `gcs`, and for `s3` when `role.enabled` is false.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for every container of the ClickHouse Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/ @raw The restricted profile ClickHouse runs under:  ```yaml allowPrivilegeEscalation: false capabilities: drop: [ALL] runAsNonRoot: true seccompProfile: type: RuntimeDefault ```

database.description: Database the collector writes metrics to.

defaultProfiles.description: Profile settings SigNoz's queries rely on. `clickhouse.profiles` overrides a single setting.

defaultSettings.description: Server settings that load the histogramQuantile function and set the format schema directory. `clickhouse.settings` overrides a single setting.

enabled.description: Install ClickHouse, with the operator and ZooKeeper it needs. When false, every component connects to `externalClickhouse` instead, and `externalClickhouse.host` must be set.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container. Names starting with `CONFIGURATION_` belong to the operator.

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container.

existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret you created that holds the password of `clickhouse.user`. When set, the chart creates no Secret. With `clickhouse.namespace` set to another namespace, the Secret must exist there and in the release namespace.

existingSecretPasswordSha256Key.description: Key of the password's SHA-256 hex inside `clickhouse.existingSecret`. When empty, the password must not contain `&`, `<` or an `&name;` sequence. Create the hash with `printf '%s' "$PASSWORD" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1`.

externalZookeeper.description: ZooKeeper that ClickHouse coordinates through instead of the bundled store, ClickHouse Keeper or ZooKeeper, whichever is on. Set that store's own `enabled` (`keeper.enabled`, `zookeeper.enabled`) to false with it, or the bundled store is still installed. @raw One `servers` entry per ZooKeeper node:  ```yaml servers: - host: signoz-signoz-zookeeper port: 2181 ```

extraInitContainers.description: Extra init containers for the Pod, run after the histogramQuantile download. The user scripts volume is `shared-binary-volume`, mounted at `/var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts`.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container.

files.description: ClickHouse configuration files, keyed by path. Files under `config.d/` merge into the server config. @raw A file that sets the server name clickhouse-client shows in its prompt:  ```yaml config.d/display_name.xml: | <clickhouse> <display_name>signoz</display_name> </clickhouse> ```

fullnameOverride.description: Name of the ClickHouseInstallation and its Service in place of `<release>-clickhouse`, and the prefix of its other objects. At most 34 characters.

image.description: Image of the ClickHouse container, also run by the histogramQuantile download init container.

repository.description: Image repository, optionally prefixed with a registry. `global.imageRegistry` replaces that registry when set.

tag.description: Image tag. SigNoz is tested against the default.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the ClickHouse Pod and the operator-upgrade hook Pod.

installCustomStorageClass.description: Create an expandable StorageClass: `gp2-resizable` when `global.cloud` starts with `aws`, `gce-resizable` when it starts with `gcp`. No volume uses it until `clickhouse.persistence.storageClass` names it.

labels.description: Labels to add to the ClickHouseInstallation.

layout.description: Shards and replicas of the ClickHouse cluster (experimental), the operator's cluster `layout` rendered as given: https://github.com/Altinity/clickhouse-operator/blob/master/docs/custom_resource_explained.md

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/ @raw A TCP check on the native port in place of the HTTP one:  ```yaml httpGet: null tcpSocket: port: 9000 ```

logDatabase.description: Database the collector writes logs to.

logs.description: Sidecar collector in the ClickHouse Pod that sends `system.query_log` entries as logs to an OTLP receiver on the node's port 4317, such as the k8s-infra agent.

config.description: Configuration of the sidecar collector, rendered as given into its config file.

enabled.description: Collect ClickHouse system table entries as logs.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container. An entry named like one the chart sets replaces it.

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container. Their volumes come from `clickhouse.extraVolumes`.

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the system logs sidecar image.

repository.description: Image repository, optionally prefixed with a registry. `global.imageRegistry` replaces that registry when set.

tag.description: Tag of the system logs sidecar image.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

meterDatabase.description: Database the collector writes meter data to.

name.description: Value of the `app.kubernetes.io/component` label on the ClickHouse objects and Pods.

nameOverride.description: Replaces `clickhouse` in the ClickHouse name `<release>-clickhouse` and in its `app.kubernetes.io/name` label.

namespace.description: Namespace of the ClickHouseInstallation. Empty means the release namespace. Any other value makes the chart create that namespace and keep it on uninstall (`helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`), and needs the operator pointed at it. @raw For a namespace `clickhouse`, either run the operator there:  ```yaml altinity-clickhouse-operator: namespaceOverride: clickhouse ```  or keep it in the release namespace with the rights to watch that one:  ```yaml altinity-clickhouse-operator: watchNamespaces: [clickhouse] rbac: namespaceScoped: false ```

operatorUpgradeHook.description: Pre-upgrade hook Job that deletes the operator Deployment an older chart created. When disabled, delete that Deployment before upgrading: `kubectl delete deployment <release>-clickhouse-operator -n <namespace>`.

backoffLimit.description: Retries before the Job, and with it the upgrade, is marked failed.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the kubectl image.

repository.description: Image repository, optionally prefixed with a registry. `global.imageRegistry` replaces that registry when set.

tag.description: Tag of the kubectl image. The image publishes no `latest` tag.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

password.description: Password of `clickhouse.user`, stored in the Secret `<clickhouse.fullname>-credentials`. Ignored when `clickhouse.existingSecret` is set. It must not contain `/`, `?` or `#`, and a `%` is read as an escape. A change does not restart the Pods.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PVC. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#access-modes

enabled.description: Keep ClickHouse data on a PersistentVolumeClaim. When false, the data lives in an `emptyDir` and is lost with the Pod, unless `clickhouse.templates.volumeClaimTemplates` provides volumes.

existingClaim.description: Name of a PersistentVolumeClaim you created for the ClickHouse data, used instead of a PVC from the template.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the ClickHouse data PVC. `-` disables dynamic provisioning, null uses the cluster default, and `global.storageClass` overrides it.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod. The `signoz.io/*` defaults make the SigNoz collectors scrape the metrics endpoint set in `clickhouse.settings`.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key named like a selector label (`app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance`, `app.kubernetes.io/component`) is ignored.

podDistribution.description: Operator rules that spread the ClickHouse Pods across nodes, rendered as given. Types: https://github.com/Altinity/clickhouse-operator/blob/1414503921da3ae475eb6f9a296d3475a6993768/docs/chi-examples/99-clickhouseinstallation-max.yaml#L428-L481

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. `null` renders none, and `{}` keeps the defaults. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

profiles.description: ClickHouse settings profiles, one key per profile and setting. They override `defaultProfiles`. Settings: https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/operations/settings/settings/ @raw A 40 GB memory cap on each query run under the default profile:  ```yaml default/max_memory_usage: 40000000000 ```

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/ @raw A TCP check on the native port in place of the HTTP one:  ```yaml httpGet: null tcpSocket: port: 9000 ```

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

secure.description: Passed as `CLICKHOUSE_SECURE` to the Pods that connect to ClickHouse.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Service.

httpPort.description: HTTP port of the ClickHouse Service, which the components connect to.

tcpPort.description: Native TCP port of the ClickHouse Service, which SigNoz, the collector and the migrator connect to.

type.description: Type of the ClickHouse Service. `LoadBalancer` or `NodePort` exposes ClickHouse outside the cluster.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the ClickHouse Pod. When false the Pod runs as `name`, or as `default` when `name` is empty.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to create (empty: the ClickHouse name), or of an existing one to run as when `create` is false.

settings.description: ClickHouse server settings, keyed by their path in the server config. They override `defaultSettings`. The `prometheus/*` defaults serve the metrics that `clickhouse.pod.annotations` point at. Settings: https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/operations/server-configuration-parameters/settings @raw Debug logging, the `level` setting under `logger`:  ```yaml logger/level: debug ```

startupProbe.description: Startup probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/ @raw A TCP check on the native port in place of the HTTP one:  ```yaml httpGet: null tcpSocket: port: 9000 ```

templates.description: Volume claim templates of the ClickHouse installation, used only when `clickhouse.persistence.enabled` is false.

volumeClaimTemplates.description: Volume claim templates added when `persistence.enabled` is false. Mount each through `clickhouse.extraVolumeMounts` under the same `name`. Without a mount at `/var/lib/clickhouse` the data is not kept. @raw Each entry takes these four fields, here a 50Gi PVC named `data`:  ```yaml - name: data accessModes: - ReadWriteOnce resources: requests: storage: 50Gi storageClassName: standard ```

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

traceDatabase.description: Database the collector writes traces to.

command.description: Command of the histogramQuantile download init container.

enabled.description: Download the histogramQuantile binary from GitHub in an init container. SigNoz's histogram percentile queries call it. When false, supply the binary through `clickhouse.extraInitContainers`.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container. @raw A proxy for the download, and a credential from a Secret for a mirror that `command` fetches from:  ```yaml - name: https_proxy value: http://proxy.example.com:3128 - name: MIRROR_TOKEN valueFrom: secretKeyRef: name: mirror-credentials key: token ```

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container. Their volumes come from `clickhouse.extraVolumes`.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

user.description: ClickHouse user the installation creates and every component connects as.

verify.description: Passed as `CLICKHOUSE_VERIFY` to the Pods that connect to ClickHouse.

clusterName.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster, which the SigNoz collectors attach to telemetry data.

externalClickhouse.description: External ClickHouse configuration. Required when `clickhouse.enabled` is false, and used only then.

cluster.description: Cluster of the external ClickHouse that the migrator creates SigNoz's tables on and SigNoz queries.

database.description: Database the collector writes metrics to.

existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret you created that holds the password of `externalClickhouse.user`. When set, the chart creates no Secret and the components read this one.

httpPort.description: HTTP port of the external ClickHouse.

logDatabase.description: Database the collector writes logs to.

meterDatabase.description: Database the collector writes meter data to.

password.description: Password of `externalClickhouse.user`, written into the Secret `<clickhouse.fullname>-credentials` that the components read. Ignored when `externalClickhouse.existingSecret` is set.

secure.description: Connect to an external ClickHouse behind TLS by appending `?secure=true` to the SigNoz and migrator connection strings. Set `externalClickhouse.tcpPort` to its secure port, usually 9440, and add the same parameters to the exporter connection strings in `otelCollector.config`.

tcpPort.description: Native TCP port of the external ClickHouse.

traceDatabase.description: Database the collector writes traces to.

verify.description: Verify the server's TLS certificate when `externalClickhouse.secure` is true. False appends `&skip_verify=true` to the SigNoz and migrator connection strings. Add it to the exporter connection strings in `otelCollector.config` yourself.

global.description: Global override values for the chart.

cloud.description: Cloud provider and distribution of the Kubernetes cluster. One of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp`, `gcp/autogke`, `hcloud` or `other`. The chart selects the StorageClass for PersistentVolumes from this value. With `aws` or `gcp` and `installCustomStorageClass` enabled, the chart creates an expandable StorageClass.

clusterDomain.description: Kubernetes cluster domain. ClickHouse, its operator and ZooKeeper build their Pods' host names on it, as does the address of a component in another namespace.

clusterName.description: Kubernetes cluster name. The resource detection processor attaches it to telemetry data.

imagePullSecrets.description: Global image pull secrets, as a list of Secret names. Not applied to the `altinity-clickhouse-operator` subchart.

imageRegistry.description: Global image registry override. Not applied to the `altinity-clickhouse-operator` subchart and `postgresql` images.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the SigNoz, ClickHouse and ZooKeeper PVCs. When set, it overrides their own `persistence.storageClass`. When neither is set, the PVCs use the cluster's default StorageClass. `-` renders an empty `storageClassName`, which disables dynamic provisioning.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets, as a list of Secret names. Not applied to the `altinity-clickhouse-operator` and `zookeeper` subcharts.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ClickHouseKeeperInstallation.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container.

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name, the name of the ClickHouseKeeperInstallation. With the default name, the release name can have at most 27 characters.

repository.description: Image repository, optionally prefixed with a registry. `global.imageRegistry` replaces that registry when set.

tag.description: Image tag. It does not follow `clickhouse.image.tag`. A Keeper restart drops every ClickHouse session.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the Keeper Pod.

labels.description: Labels to add to the ClickHouseKeeperInstallation. A key that names a chart label replaces its value.

name.description: Name of the ClickHouse Keeper component, the `app.kubernetes.io/name` label of its objects. `keeper.nameOverride` takes precedence.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PVC. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#access-modes

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the PVC. `-` disables dynamic provisioning, null uses the cluster default, and `global.storageClass` overrides it.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod. Set a key to `null` to drop a default. `signoz.io/port` must equal `prometheus/port` in `keeper.settings`.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key named like a selector label (`app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance`, `app.kubernetes.io/component`) is ignored.

podDistribution.description: Topologies for distributing the ClickHouse Keeper Pods, in the operator's `podDistribution` format.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. `null` renders none, and `{}` keeps the defaults. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Keeper needs a majority of its replicas to work.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

settings.description: ClickHouse Keeper server settings. Set a key to `null` to drop a default. `prometheus/port` must equal the `signoz.io/port` annotation in `keeper.pod.annotations`.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Deployment.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for the collector container and its `check` init container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container. An entry named like one the chart sets replaces it. The chart sets the `CLICKHOUSE_*` and `K8S_*` variables and `LOW_CARDINAL_EXCEPTION_GROUPING`. @raw Group exceptions with low cardinality:  ```yaml - name: LOW_CARDINAL_EXCEPTION_GROUPING value: "true" ```

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the container, added after the chart's `--config`, `--manager-config` and `--copy-path`.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the collector container and its `check` init container.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the collector Pod, as a list of Secret names.

hosts.description: Hosts and paths of the Ingress.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Deployment. A key that repeats a chart label replaces its value.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

minReadySeconds.description: Seconds a new Pod must be ready before it counts as available. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#min-ready-seconds

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod. Set a key to `null` to drop a default. A `checksum/config` key is ignored.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key named like a selector label is ignored.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

ports.description: Port configuration. Each entry is a port of the collector container and of its Service. An entry of your own needs `enabled`, `containerPort`, `servicePort` and `protocol`. Its name is a port name of at most 15 characters.

progressDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the Deployment may take to progress before it is marked failed. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#progress-deadline-seconds

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe for the container. It holds the liveness and readiness probes back until it succeeds. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

additionalVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Postgres objects.

existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret you created that holds the password. When set, the chart creates no Secret and ignores `auth.password`.

password.description: Password of the user, stored in the Secret `<fullname>-auth` under the key `password`. Ignored when `auth.existingSecret` is set.

enabled.description: Install PostgreSQL. Switching an existing release from SQLite to Postgres needs a new release.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the container.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the Postgres Pod.

failureThreshold.description: Failure threshold of the liveness probe.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay of the liveness probe, in seconds.

periodSeconds.description: Period of the liveness probe, in seconds.

successThreshold.description: Success threshold of the liveness probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of the liveness probe, in seconds.

namespace.description: Namespace of Postgres. Empty means the release namespace.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PVC. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#access-modes

dataDir.description: Data directory of Postgres (`PGDATA`). It must be a subdirectory of `persistence.mountPath`. A container that does not run as root cannot initialize the `data` directory. Use `/var/lib/postgresql/pgdata` for it.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to use. Rendered as a template. `{{ .Release.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Name }}` names the PVC `<release>-postgresql`.

mountPath.description: Mount path of the data PVC. At `/var/lib/postgresql`, the chart also mounts the PVC's `data` directory at `/var/lib/postgresql/data`, so the database is on the PVC. Not applied to the official `postgres` image at tag 18 or later, or when an `additionalVolumeMounts` entry uses that path. At any other path, `persistence.dataDir` must be under this one.

subPath.description: Subpath of the PVC that holds the Postgres data.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

failureThreshold.description: Failure threshold of the readiness probe.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay of the readiness probe, in seconds.

periodSeconds.description: Period of the readiness probe, in seconds.

successThreshold.description: Success threshold of the readiness probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of the readiness probe, in seconds.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

securityContext.description: Security context for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Service.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Service.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. When empty and `create` is true, the chart generates one.

enabled.description: Enable the startup probe. It passes once Postgres answers and no dump waits at `backups/pre-upgrade.sql`. The liveness and readiness probes start only after it passes.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the container is restarted. With the default period, a first start has 30 minutes to load a dump.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Delay before the first startup probe.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes for the startup probe to pass. Kubernetes accepts only 1.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Time limit of the Job. When it passes, the Job and the upgrade fail. A value of 300 or more needs `helm upgrade --timeout` raised with it.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Job. The `helm.sh/hook`, `helm.sh/hook-weight` and `helm.sh/hook-delete-policy` keys are ignored.

enabled.description: Run the pre-upgrade hook Job that dumps a database not on the PVC, for the new Pod to load. Not run on `helm install`, without persistence, with a `persistence.mountPath` other than `/var/lib/postgresql`, with a `persistence.dataDir` outside it, with an `additionalVolumeMounts` entry at or above the data directory, with a `ReadWriteOncePod` PVC, or with `replicaCount: 0`. It runs on the Postgres Pod's node. While that Pod is absent, the upgrade fails after `activeDeadlineSeconds` with `DeadlineExceeded`. When false without a dump taken by hand, a database that is not on the PVC is lost: https://signoz.io/docs/operate/migration/upgrade-0-152/

nodeSelector.description: Node labels for Pod assignment. They must match the node of the Postgres Pod.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod.

podLabels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key the chart also sets keeps the chart's value.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container. `null` sets none, and `{}` keeps the defaults.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for Pod assignment, added to the Postgres Pod's `tolerations`.

redpanda.description: redpanda subchart values. Configurable with the licensed version of SigNoz.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the StatefulSet.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container, as `NAME: value`. A key named like a variable the chart sets replaces it. A string, number or boolean is the value. A map is the rest of the EnvVar, such as `valueFrom`. The names follow the SigNoz configuration: `provider` under `telemetry_store` is `signoz_telemetrystore_provider`. When a key is set in both cases, the lower-case one wins. Set a default to `null` to remove it. All names: https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz/blob/main/conf/example.yaml @raw A plain value and a value from a Secret:  ```yaml MY_KEY: my-value SECRET_KEY: valueFrom: secretKeyRef: name: my-secret key: my-key ```

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the container. A variable of the same name in `signoz.env` or set by the chart takes precedence.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the container, added after the image's own.

extraContainers.description: Extra containers for the Pod. The SQLite database is on the PVC `signoz-db`, mounted at `/var/lib/signoz`.

extraInitContainers.description: Extra init containers for the Pod.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the container.

repository.description: Image repository, with its registry. `global.imageRegistry` replaces that registry when set.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means the chart's `appVersion`.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the SigNoz Pod.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress.

hosts.description: Hosts and paths of the Ingress. A path without `port` routes to `signoz.service.port`, and a path without `pathType` gets `ImplementationSpecific`.

tls.description: TLS settings of the Ingress, as entries with `hosts` and an optional `secretName`. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#tls

labels.description: Labels to add to the StatefulSet. A key that matches a chart label replaces it.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Set a field to `null` to drop it. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

name.description: Name of the SigNoz component, the `app.kubernetes.io/component` selector label. An upgrade cannot change it.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PVC. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#access-modes

enabled.description: Enable persistence with a PersistentVolumeClaim. When false, the SQLite database is in an `emptyDir`. Ignored when `postgresql.enabled` is true.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to use. Only used when `signoz.persistence.enabled` is true.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the PVC. `-` disables dynamic provisioning, and `global.storageClass` overrides it.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key named like a selector label is ignored.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the container. `null` renders none. A handler other than `httpGet` must also set `httpGet: null`. Set a field to `null` to drop it. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. With SQLite, each replica has its own database.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Service.

internalNodePort.description: NodePort for the internal API. Only used when `signoz.service.type` is `NodePort`.

internalPort.description: Service port for the internal API. The container port stays 8085.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Service. A key that matches a chart label replaces it.

nodePort.description: NodePort for HTTP. Only used when `signoz.service.type` is `NodePort`.

opampInternalNodePort.description: NodePort for OpAMP. Only used when `signoz.service.type` is `NodePort`.

opampPort.description: Service port for OpAMP. The container port stays 4320.

port.description: Service port of the HTTP API and UI. The container port stays 8080.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Empty means the release's full name when `create` is true, and `default` otherwise.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe for the container. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

signoz-otel-gateway.description: signoz-otel-gateway subchart values. Configurable with the licensed version of SigNoz.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the Job, merged over the chart's `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Force=true,Replace=true`. A value for that key replaces the chart's.

containerSecurityContext.description: Security context for the migration containers. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

enabled.description: Enable the telemetry store migrator, a Job that runs on every install and upgrade. The collector's `check` init container waits for its migrations.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the migration containers and the collector's `check` init container. An entry named like one the chart sets replaces it.

envFrom.description: Sources of extra environment variables for the migration containers and the collector's `check` init container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the migration containers.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Job. A key the chart also sets takes your value.

name.description: Name of the migrator component. The Job is named `<name>-<release revision>`. At most 57 characters.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod.

labels.description: Labels to add to the Pod. A key the chart also sets keeps the chart's value.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context for the Pod. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the migration containers and the collector's `check` init container.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount of the migrator Job; by default none is created and the Job runs as `default`. Set `create: true` when a policy or credential is bound to a ServiceAccount. On an install from a chart before 0.152.0, first delete the old `signoz-telemetrystore-migrator` ServiceAccount or upgrade with `--take-ownership`.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Pod assignment. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds Kubernetes keeps a finished migrator Job, and its logs, before deleting it. Set it (for example `604800`) to clean up Jobs a failed upgrade leaves behind. Leave it unset under Argo CD, which recreates a deleted Job and re-runs the migrator. Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/ttlafterfinished/

zookeeper.description: Values of the bundled ZooKeeper chart, which ClickHouse coordinates through when `zookeeper.enabled` is true. Its keys follow Bitnami's chart: https://github.com/bitnami/charts/blob/main/bitnami/zookeeper/values.yaml
